from mathutils import Vector
rng = random.Random(7)                                   # seeded: same layout on every rebuild (user_edits.json stays valid)
scn = bpy.context.scene

def coll_height(coll):
    return max((o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)).z for o in coll.all_objects for c in o.bound_box)

def scatter_instances(coll, spots, cap_objs=(), cap_chance=0.35):
    out, last = [], None
    for i, (x, y) in enumerate(spots):
        inst = bpy.data.objects.new(f"{coll.name}_{i:02d}", None)
        inst.instance_type = 'COLLECTION'; inst.instance_collection = coll
        inst.location = (x, y, 0)
        a = rng.choice([0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5])
        while a == last: a = rng.choice([0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5])   # never the same angle side by side
        last = a
        inst.rotation_euler = (0, 0, a * math.pi / 2 * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1))
        scn.collection.objects.link(inst)
        if cap_objs and rng.random() < cap_chance:                          # top-piece variant
            cap = rng.choice(cap_objs).copy()                               # .copy() keeps linked mesh data
            cap.location = (x, y, coll_height(coll)); scn.collection.objects.link(cap)
        out.append(inst)
    return out

    a = o.modifiers.new("Array", 'ARRAY'); a.count = count
    a.use_relative_offset = True; a.relative_offset_displace = axis
    return o

def grad_card(name, mode="alpha", gtype="LINEAR", strength=10, rot_z=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True; N, L = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    N.remove(N["Principled BSDF"]); out = N["Material Output"]
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord"); mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping"); mp.inputs["Rotation"].default_value[2] = rot_z
    gr = N.new("ShaderNodeTexGradient"); gr.gradient_type = gtype
    cr = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB"); cr.color_ramp.interpolation = "B_SPLINE"
    em = N.new("ShaderNodeEmission"); em.inputs["Strength"].default_value = strength
    L.new(tc.outputs["UV"], mp.inputs["Vector"]); L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], gr.inputs["Vector"])
    L.new(gr.outputs["Fac"], cr.inputs["Fac"])
    if mode == "alpha":            # key-to-realistic: fade via transparency
        tr = N.new("ShaderNodeBsdfTransparent"); mx = N.new("ShaderNodeMixShader")
        L.new(cr.outputs["Color"], mx.inputs["Fac"]); L.new(tr.outputs["BSDF"], mx.inputs[1])
        L.new(em.outputs["Emission"], mx.inputs[2]); L.new(mx.outputs["Shader"], out.inputs["Surface"])
    elif mode == "color":          # realistic product: gradient into Emission Color
        L.new(cr.outputs["Color"], em.inputs["Color"]); L.new(em.outputs["Emission"], out.inputs["Surface"])
    else:                          # car animation: gradient × 20 into Emission Strength
        mul = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mul.operation = 'MULTIPLY'; mul.inputs[1].default_value = 20
        L.new(cr.outputs["Color"], mul.inputs[0]); L.new(mul.outputs[0], em.inputs["Strength"])
        L.new(em.outputs["Emission"], out.inputs["Surface"])
    return m

def photo_emit(name, path, strength=10.0, invert_ramp=None, tint=None):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); N, L = m.node_tree.nodes, m.node_tree.links
    b = N["Principled BSDF"]
    img = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage"); img.image = bpy.data.images.load(path)
    if invert_ramp:                                   # (lo, hi) ramp stops, e.g. (0.35, 0.55)
        inv = N.new("ShaderNodeInvert"); cr = N.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
        cr.color_ramp.elements[0].position, cr.color_ramp.elements[1].position = invert_ramp
        L.new(img.outputs["Color"], inv.inputs["Color"]); L.new(inv.outputs["Color"], cr.inputs["Factor"])
        L.new(cr.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Alpha"])
    else:
        L.new(img.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Alpha"])
    if tint:                                          # single-colour neon
        cv = N.new("ShaderNodeRGBCurve"); cv.mapping.curves[3].points[1].location = (0.6, 1.0)   # ~ blow out
        hsv = N.new("ShaderNodeHueSaturation"); hsv.inputs["Color"].default_value = tint
        L.new(img.outputs["Color"], cv.inputs["Color"]); L.new(cv.outputs["Color"], hsv.inputs["Value"])
        L.new(hsv.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Emission Color"])
    else:
        L.new(img.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Emission Color"])
    b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = strength
    m.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"               # EEVEE Next; replaces blend_method
    return m

from mathutils import Vector
from bpy_extras.object_utils import world_to_camera_view as w2c
scn = bpy.context.scene; cam = scn.camera
focal3 = bpy.data.objects["Hero"].matrix_world.translation
for name in ["Plank", "Rail", "Cable"]:                     # ~ example props
    ob = bpy.data.objects[name]

    ob.rotation_euler.z = math.atan2(d.y, d.x)               # long axis = local X (~ check model)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
def p2(v): q = w2c(scn, cam, v); return Vector((q.x, q.y))
focal = p2(focal3)
def miss(a, b):                                              # focal's distance from the 2D line a→b
    d = (b - a).normalized(); n = Vector((-d.y, d.x)); return abs((focal - a).dot(n))

    o = bpy.data.objects[name]
    a, b = p2(o.matrix_world @ Vector((0, 0, 0))), p2(o.matrix_world @ Vector((1, 0, 0)))
    print(name, "miss", round(miss(a, b), 3))               # < ~0.05 = leads to the focal point

def frame_same(cam, target, lens):
    # keep subject size: distance scales with focal length
    d = (cam.location - target).length
    new_d = d * lens / cam.data.lens
    fwd = (target - cam.location).normalized()
    cam.location = target - fwd * new_d
    cam.data.lens = lens
